The '''Shattered City''' was the name given to the settlement built atop [[Perekta Mesa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makeb]] that was destroyed during the numerous [[Groundquake/Legends|groundquakes]] that occurred during the [[Conquest of Makeb]]. Numerous cracks in the mesa ripped apart the settlement, with only the eastern chunk of the city remaining mostly intact.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Shattered City appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Rise of the Hutt Cartel]]'', a [[2013]] Digital Expansion for the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
